name: critical-at-every-higher-threshold-must-pass
description: Wilson-bound critical_at: 0.9 (80 pos) has LB(80/80) = 0.9542 >= 0.95. At 0.8 (adds 20 pos, 1 neg) LB(100/101) = 0.9460 fails, so the scan stops even though 0.7 (adds 200 pos) would reach LB(300/301) = 0.9814: every judgeable threshold above critical_at must pass. critical_at = 0.9 with 80 predicted positives.
